resources.string: Runs once at that time, then leaves the list (it stays in the run history).
Runs %1$s, counting from when you save.
Pick a time that hasn\'t passed yet
Fill in what to do to save
As usual: asks before editing files or running commands
Edits files without asking; still asks before commands
Reads code and writes a plan; acts only once you approve
Judges the risk itself and just does the safe things

Scheduled tasks run in the background. When one needs your approval, your phone is notified, and it waits until someone taps. To let it run commands without asking, pick Auto (it judges the risk itself).
When it continues the original chat, that chat switches to these settings too.
Allow everything: it runs commands and edits files without asking you.

While this task runs, it won\'t ask before running any command, editing any file or using any tool, and nobody can stop it halfway. Only use it for prompts you trust and whose mistakes you can live with.
The next run will start a new chat
Every run goes into the chat that scheduled it and carries on with what\'s there.
Every run goes into this task\'s own chat, so it can see earlier results. When the chat gets long or you want a fresh start, tap New chat next time; the old chat stays.
The first run starts a new chat, and every run after that carries on in it, so it can see earlier results.
Adds it first, then runs it once
Pushes the answer to your phone after every run.

Pushes only when a run decides you need to know and alerts you; otherwise it stays quiet. Errors and interruptions are pushed as usual. These tasks always run in their own chat, and messages you send in that chat aren\'t pushed when done either.
Pushes only when it alerts you
When done, put it in the Inbox
Nothing is added to your Inbox.
A row is added to your Inbox only when a run finds something worth a look. Tapping it opens that chat.
Every run adds a row to your Inbox, so you can follow up. Tapping it opens that chat.
